Privacy &
your information.

A straightforward explanation of how this website’s features work.

Contact and appointment forms

These forms collect the name, email address and enquiry or appointment details that you choose to provide. They submit directly to Finrel’s existing website at finrelpharmacy.com for processing. This redesign does not store submissions in a separate database or in your browser.

A request is not a confirmed appointment. Please contact your chosen branch to confirm arrangements. Do not include medical records, payment details or other sensitive information in the general enquiry form.

External services

Online shopping links take you to finrelonline.com. Directions open Google Maps with the branch’s published address. Social links open Finrel’s published social profiles. Those services handle information under their own policies.

Your browser

This redesign does not add analytics, marketing cookies or browser storage. Branch searching and filtering happen on your device. The hosting provider may process standard connection information to serve the website.

Questions about your information

Contact Finrel customer care on 0813 707 2624 or the corporate head office on 08174993652.
